SELECT p."Id", p."RunId", p."PlanId", p."CallerIntentId", p."AdmissionSequence", p."RequestFingerprint", p."PreparationFingerprint", p."PreparedAtUtc", p."AcceptedAtUtc", p."Execute", p."State", p."LinkDeliveryState", p."DeliveredLinkId", p."LinkConflictReason", p."PublicFailure", p."AcceptedSourceVersion", p."AcceptedSourceHeaderJson", p."AcceptedSourceHeaderFingerprint", CASE
    WHEN p."AcceptedSourceVersion" = 0 THEN p."PayloadJson"
    ELSE ''
END, p1."AdmissionId" IS NULL OR p1."StepInstanceId" IS NULL, p1."PayloadJson", p1."Fingerprint"
FROM process_prepared_launches AS p
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT p0."AdmissionId", p0."StepInstanceId", p0."Fingerprint", p0."PayloadJson"
    FROM process_accepted_assignment_sources AS p0
    WHERE p0."StepInstanceId" = @stepId_Value
) AS p1 ON p."Id" = p1."AdmissionId"
WHERE p."Id" = @admissionId
LIMIT 2
